newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish KPW clears steel trader for public trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish KPW clears steel trader for public trade.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) cleared the 5,331,487 existing and one million shares of a planned new issue of steel products trader Centrostal SA, a subsidary of Stalexport, KPW said in a statement.

The president of the company told a news conference the company, which wants to enter the parallel market of the bourse next year but sees a main market listing in the second half of 1997, set the minimum issue price at 4.1 zlotys.
"We set the minimum issue price at 4.1 zlotys," Zbigniew Canowicki said.
He said the shares would be offered in a public subscription December 9 to 20 and the funds from the issue would be earmarked for setting three new branches of the firm.
Centrostal had a net profit of 1.8 million zlotys on 78.6-million-zloty sales in 1995.
